claim_scope: Integral homotopy of the ordinary Lovasz open-neighborhood complex of the ten-regular Clebsch complement; complete reduced integral homology of the five-regular Clebsch dominance complex.
integrity: Self-contained standard-library verifier reconstructs all faces and matching pairs, proves matching acyclicity by full Hasse cover sort, evaluates a signed integral Morse differential with an explicit determinant-one minor, and independently checks all mod-two ranks and dominance Euler characteristic. No claim of independent external audit.
scientific_limitations: A specific 16-vertex strongly regular graph only; nonequivariant wedge type for the neighborhood complex, and integral homology but not homotopy for the dominance complex. Literature searches cannot rule out inaccessible or unindexed equivalent proofs.
title: The Clebsch-complement neighborhood complex is a wedge of 131 four-spheres
